properties.alignedTo: us-counties (same row order, sorted by FIPS)
properties.columnPattern: demShare<Y>, repShare<Y>, demTwoParty<Y>, totalVotes<Y>, turnoutProxy<Y> for each year, plus repSwing<A>_<B>
properties.sources: 2000-2020: MIT Election Data and Science Lab, County Presidential Election Returns 2000-2020, Harvard Dataverse, doi:10.7910/DVN/VOQCHQ (CC0 1.0). 2024: MIT Election Data and Science Lab precinct-level returns 2024 (github.com/MEDSL/2024-elections-official; CC0), aggregated to county by scripts/data/us-elections.
caveats: 2024 is rebuilt from precinct data and is not the official MEDSL county file; states failing reconciliation against MEDSL state totals are NaN.
Bedford city VA is folded into Bedford County (2000-2012); Shannon SD is mapped to Oglala Lakota. Alaska and Hawaii are not in us-counties.
Jackson County MO (29095) is NaN for 2024 (Kansas City reported separately in the source).
storyNotes: 2859 of 3109 counties carry 2024 returns (states rejected because MEDSL precinct files are incomplete: AK, IN, LA, NJ, NY); earlier years cover ~3,100.
County winner changes: 2012->2016 239, 2016->2020 78, 2020->2024 74 of ~2859 comparable counties.
2020->2024 largest pro-Republican swings among counties with >=50k votes: Webb, TX +12.8 pp; Imperial, CA +12.8 pp; El Paso, TX +10.2 pp; Hidalgo, TX +10.1 pp.
2020->2024 largest pro-Democratic swings among counties with >=50k votes: Henry, GA -4.6 pp; Douglas, GA -3.1 pp; Kaufman, TX -3.1 pp; Paulding, GA -2.6 pp.
Median Republican two-party swing 2020->2024 = +1.5 pp; 2016->2020 = -0.6 pp.
Connecticut is NaN (election returns use 8 legacy counties; us-counties carries 9 planning regions); Broomfield CO is NaN for 2000 (county created 2001).
